However, it adds several unsupported or overstated elements, especially an Orientation & Mobility referral, “mild exophoria” contributing to depth perception problems, and medication-label / reading-in-motion issues that are not in the source. It also introduces sunglasses/eyewear use and “driving-related refresher or assessment,” which are not supported. Overall it is close, but not a clean replacement for the reference because of those invented recommendations and findings.
